about: The small passage's trench narrower than a cell (D273), made by tools/art/narrow.py from Gemini's pictures in art/raw/ (which git ignores): the trial scene (scene-small-passage-5, the trial scene-small-passage-3 saved again), its wall enlarged with the trench painted on a guide (scene-small-passage-6), squeezed, repaired (scene-small-passage-7), its mirrored rubble painted again (scene-small-passage-8), and laid back (scene-small-passage-9), whose grid Gemini then took out (game-tower-passage-nogrid, the scene's base). Pixels of the enlargement unless said; the enlargement is columns 8 to 15 of the scene, from just above row 4's foot to just below the corridor wall's foot, at twice the scene's size.
